name: kody
description: Your assistant's home — the memory, keys, code, and automations your AI agent keeps, portable across every MCP host

scripts.deploy: node --input-type=module -e "if (['preview','test'].includes(process.env.CLOUDFLARE_ENV ?? '')) { await import('./tools/prepare-e2e-env.ts'); }" && npm run build && node --env-file=packages/worker/.env ./wrangler-env.ts deploy --outdir .wrangler/sentry-bundle --upload-source-maps
scripts.build:client:web: npm run clean:client && mkdir -p .tmp && esbuild packages/worker/client/entry.tsx --bundle --splitting --format=esm --target=es2022 --outdir=packages/worker/public --entry-names=client-entry --chunk-names=assets/[name]-[hash] --asset-names=assets/[name] --jsx=automatic --jsx-import-source=remix/ui --minify --sourcemap --metafile=.tmp/client-meta.json && node tools/build-client-manifest.ts && node node_modules/@sentry/cli/bin/sentry-cli sourcemaps inject packages/worker/public/assets packages/worker/public/client-entry.js packages/worker/public/client-entry.js.map
scripts.migrate:local: node tools/apply-local-app-migrations.ts && node --env-file=packages/worker/.env ./wrangler-env.ts d1 migrations apply AUDIT_DB --local && node --env-file=packages/worker/.env ./wrangler-env.ts d1 migrations apply JOBS_DB --local --config packages/jobs-worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.migrate:e2e: node tools/apply-local-app-migrations.ts --persist-to .wrangler/state/e2e && node --env-file=packages/worker/.env ./wrangler-env.ts d1 migrations apply AUDIT_DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/state/e2e && node --env-file=packages/worker/.env ./wrangler-env.ts d1 migrations apply JOBS_DB --local --config packages/jobs-worker/wrangler.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/state/e2e
scripts.preview: nx run worker:build-client && npm run migrate:local && node --env-file=packages/worker/.env ./wrangler-env.ts dev --local
scripts.preview:e2e: node --env-file=packages/worker/.env tools/prepare-e2e-env.ts && nx run worker:build-client && npm run migrate:e2e && node --env-file=packages/worker/.env ./wrangler-env.ts dev --local --persist-to .wrangler/state/e2e
scripts.typecheck: nx run worker:typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p packages/backup-control-plane/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/status/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/jobs-worker/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:push: CI=1 npm run test && CI=1 npm run test:e2e:run
scripts.validate: concurrently -n format,lint,typecheck,test,e2e,mcp,backup-build,status-build,jobs-build,runtime-build,primitives,migrations,deploy-guardrails,docs -c green,yellow,magenta,blue,cyan,red,blueBright,yellowBright,cyanBright,cyan,white,gray,redBright,greenBright "npm run format:check" "npm run lint" "npm run typecheck" "CI=1 npm run test" "CI=1 npm run test:e2e:run" "npm run test:mcp" "npm run backup:build" "npm run status:build" "npm run jobs:build" "npm run runtime:build" "npm run primitives:check" "npm run migrations:check" "npm run deploy-guardrails:check" "npm run docs:check-temporal"
scripts.validate:fix: npm run format && npm run lint:fix
